compiler_equivalence: final-rewrite-equivalence.json proves identical selection CSV and rewritten bitcode for all 8 measured inputs after the cache optimization
summary_method: Arithmetic mean of all uninstrumented rows in the stated stage/case; CXL/Local is ratio of arithmetic means. Individual paired ratios and full ranges retained. No outlier removal. Instrumented and correctness-only runs excluded.

timing_scope.contention: start barrier release through worker joins; prefill and complete value validation excluded
timing_scope.universal: unmodified upstream synchronized worker interval; request success/failure checks remain in its loop
timing_scope.hardware_profiles: whole process including setup/validation, separate from uninstrumented timings

limitations: HITM-risk evidence is not a prediction of CXL speedup or proof of sharing.
Thread/list ABI models tested with LLVM 18 and libstdc++ 11.
Contiguous integer hot keys alter spatial locality along with sharing.
Universal ratios count attempts; updates can miss and successful updates write the existing default value.
Host governor schedutil and boost unchanged; no CPU cache flushing.
Experimental TTAS/padding headers are isolated build copies; default source/build remain upstream.
Early short screens are exploratory only, not confirmation or proof of speedup.
build_artifacts: Ignored build/libcuckoo-rmw contains bitcode, binaries, all raw logs and perf data.
archive_csv_line_endings: LF; field values preserved, original build files unchanged
xindex_replay_manifest_note: Replay began with the implementation uncommitted on base main (15 dirty files). Retained binary/plugin hashes identify the measured artifacts; implementation subsequently committed as e71758d. The later analysis-cache commit leaves all measured rewrites identical.
hardware_sample_attribution: Successful mbind extents of selected arena, including allocator metadata; compressed decoded samples retained. This is not an exact allocation-boundary attribution.
